learning_outcomes.text: Give students a basic instrument for applied programming (C language).
Introduce students to main concepts of the Object Oriented programming style (C++).
Examine basic data types in C/C++ program processing and basic operations executed with them.
Develop algorithms as a basis for composing a program.
Acquire skills for developing application programs.

syllabus_topics: Basic data types and operations in C++ programs
Controlling structures – conditional branches, variant choice, cycles
Components of classes – data members, functions members, constructors and destructors
assessment_rules: The semester is finished successfully if the student successfully defends the course assignments. The final grade is a result of continuous assessment, formed from 2 control workshops, the test score and the self-prepared tasks.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Industrial Engineering (Bachelor)
